dogecoin.text: @PeterSchiff @jfnewbery It’s not just about making money, it’s about keeping it. Care to guess whether Bitcoin or Dogecoin will retain more of its gains 12 months from now?

@PeterSchiff The hash power of the Bitcoin network is about 1,000,000x larger than the hashpower of the Dogecoin network. Bitcoin can survive a 51% attack from nation states. Dogecoin would be obliterated by an attack from nation states or even the Bitcoin network. Bitcoin is decentralized.
@intocryptoverse It must be the new Dogecoin.
